# Where the fixture came from

`talk6.mp3` — 6 minutes 30 seconds from *Telling Time on Other Worlds*, NASA's *Houston We Have a Podcast*,
24 April 2026, taken from 7:00 so the opening music is not in it. Mono, 32 kHz, 48 kbit/s MP3 — mp3 because that is what podcasts are, and because it is the harder case for the clip cut: the output container is mp4, so a copy is not always possible and the path that re-encodes gets exercised.

NASA material is generally not copyrighted (17 U.S.C. §105; NASA's media usage guidelines). It is used here
as a test input only. Nobody in it is claimed to use or endorse anything.

Source: https://www.nasa.gov/podcasts/houston-we-have-a-podcast/

**It is a different recording from the one on the page.** The sample on the page is *Artemis II: The Crew*.
A gate fixture is never also the material the tool was tuned on (Quality.md, 2026-09-19).
